title_en: In the Courtroom (10/20): The Security Deposit Dispute
note_en: To say where something is taken from, Chinese often frames the source with 从…里: 从押金里扣钱 "deduct money from the deposit." English needs only "from," but Chinese adds 里 ("inside") after the noun even for an abstract amount of money, and the whole 从… phrase goes before the verb 扣.
